items.citation_text: ARH Appoints Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → Interim President and CEO appointed; short acting-CEO period concluded → The Board appointed Pierre Noel Interim President and CEO, effective July 13, 2026, during recruitment for a permanent CEO. The announcement also records that Raeline McGrath, Vice President of Patient Care and Chief Nursing Executive, had served as Acting President and CEO during the preceding few weeks. This is one transition event, but it documents two leadership changes: McGrath temporarily assuming the CEO authorities after the previous CEO’s departure, followed by Noel assuming the interim role. → July 9, 2026 announcement; July 13, 2026 effective date → Arnprior Regional Health → ARH Appoints Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO

items.citation_text: Public Statement
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → President and CEO departure → Jeremy Stevenson stepped down as President and CEO on June 2, 2026. The hospital’s public statement thanked him for his service and cited his work on organizational strategic goals, the regional Epic electronic medical record initiative, communication, patient care, and advocacy for local health-care needs. The source does not give a reason for the departure or identify an immediate successor, so no reason should be inferred. → June 2, 2026 → Arnprior Regional Health → Public Statement

items.citation_text: ARH and QCH to Implement Joint Chief of Staff
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → Chief of Staff succession and joint medical-leadership model → Arnprior Regional Health and Queensway Carleton Hospital announced a joint Chief of Staff model, appointing Dr. Kathi Kovacs to serve both hospitals effective August 1, 2025. The announcement states that Dr. Florin Padeanu, who had served as Arnprior Regional Health Chief of Staff since 2022, would leave that leadership role while continuing to care for patients through his primary-care practice and as an inpatient hospitalist. Because the effective date falls within the requested window, the change is included even though the announcement preceded it. → June 27, 2025 announcement; August 1, 2025 effective date → Arnprior Regional Health → ARH and QCH to Implement Joint Chief of Staff

items.citation_text: ARH Board of Directors Appoints New Chair
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → Board Chair transition → Following the 2024 Annual General Meeting, the Board appointed Oliver Jacob Chair for a three-year term ending in June 2027. Cathy Jordan completed three years as Chair but, at the time of the announcement, was to continue as a director. This was therefore a change in Board officer rather than an immediate departure from the Board. → July 3, 2024 → Arnprior Regional Health → ARH Board of Directors Appoints New Chair

items.citation_text: Board announces new CEO; Annual Report to the Community 2023-24; ARH Board of Directors Appoints New Chair
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → New President and CEO appointed; prior CEO retired → After a recruitment process, the Board appointed Jeremy Stevenson as the next President and CEO. The announcement identified Leah Levesque as the current CEO whose leadership he would succeed and stated that Stevenson would join the organization on August 18, 2024. A separate 2023/24 annual report described Levesque as signing off from the role, while the Board-chair transition announcement called her the recently retired CEO. → May 10, 2024 announcement; August 18, 2024 start date → Arnprior Regional Health → Board announces new CEO; Annual Report to the Community 2023-24; ARH Board of Directors Appoints New Chair

items.citation_text: Arnprior Regional Health Board appoints three new directors
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → Three directors appointed; two directors departed → At the 2023 Annual General Meeting, the Board confirmed Richard “Rick” Holock, Peter “Pete” Kenny, and Borys Koba as new directors. The stated initial terms were three years for Holock, one year for Kenny, and three years for Koba. The organization also announced the departure of Erin Stitt-Cavanagh, who had served seven years and held several Board leadership positions, and Bob McGaraughty, who had joined in 2022. → July 18, 2023 → Arnprior Regional Health → Arnprior Regional Health Board appoints three new directors

items.date_raw: July 4, 2022 announcement; changes associated with the June 28, 2022 AGM
items.citation_text: ARH Board celebrates long-serving directors and appoints new director and committee member
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → One director appointed; five directors departed → At the June 28, 2022 Annual General Meeting, the Board appointed Beth Ciavaglia as a new director. Five directors left: Barb Darlow, a director since 2013 and Board Chair from 2015 to 2021; Donna Anderson, a director since 2013 who had served as Vice-Chair and Governance Committee Chair; Barbara Kieley, a director since 2020 and Resources Planning and Audit Committee Chair; Mark MacGown, a director since 2020; and Tyler Pirie, a director since 2019 and Quality Committee Chair. The announcement also named Maggie Harbert to the Quality Committee, but that committee-only appointment is not counted as a Board-member change. → July 4, 2022 announcement; changes associated with the June 28, 2022 AGM → Arnprior Regional Health → ARH Board celebrates long-serving directors and appoints new director and committee member

items.citation_text: Arnprior Regional Health will welcome new President and CEO this fall
items.verbatim_snippet: Arnprior Regional Health → President and CEO succession → The Board appointed Levesque as President and CEO effective October 1, 2021. She replaced Eric Hanna, who retired on September 30, 2021 after leading the organization for 13 years. Before the appointment, Levesque was Vice President of Patient Care and Chief Nursing Executive at Queensway Carleton Hospital and had previously spent six years in a senior leadership position at Arnprior Regional Health. → August 19, 2021 announcement; September 30 and October 1, 2021 transition dates → Arnprior Regional Health → Arnprior Regional Health will welcome new President and CEO this fall
